content:
sanjeev: quick heads-up — ran int4 conversion + perf smoke for saffron-13b on the new quant pipeline and seeing a reproducible drift in long-context summaries after ~2k tokens. not a pure perf regression (latency fine) but content degradation. attaching short logs and prompts below.

emma: ugh. does it replicate on gemma/qwen variants or only saffron?

sanjeev: tried saffron and a local gemma-lite build. gemma-lite seemed OK. saffron shows the issue when we use the new rotary folding optimization + our tokenizer remap. suspect token id offset or rotary phase misapply.

kai: can you paste the exact conversion command you used?

sanjeev: sure — run this inside the conversion job:
```bash
python -m redwood.tools.convert --model saffron-13b --out saffron-int4 --quant=lut-int4 --rotary-fix=folded --tokenmap remap_v2.json
```

caroline: noted. did you run the kv-cache warmup step? sometimes long-context drift appears only after kv warmup mismatch.

sanjeev: yes — we warm up with 512 token prefix and then run a 4k context chat. the regression appears around token 2100 consistently.

emma: any numeric diffs? log snippets?

sanjeev: pasted an eval excerpt:
```
BASELINE saffron-fp16: rougeL=0.42, perplexity=18.7
CONVERT saffron-int4: rougeL=0.31, perplexity=28.3
EMBED drift: cosine drop 0.11 -> 0.04 vs baseline on paste+recall test
```

kai: that is big. could be rotary scale mismatch causing attention to attenuate older KV entries. do you see headwise pattern?

sanjeev: inspected attention-sums per head — heads 2,5,7 show early decay after quantization. also noticed token id 0x2c7 remapped to different slot compared to baseline (off-by-one in remap table).

caroline: @kai can you try running the quick adapter that forces legacy rotary scaling (scale=1.0) on one shard? see if that eliminates drift.

kai: running now on a single GPU shard. will report in ~3m.

ml-ci-bot: conversion-job-1733332222 started: saffron-13b -> saffron-int4 (lut-int4), job_id=conv-9812

ml-ci-bot: conversion-job-1733332222 status: finished, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-onboard/saffron/conv-9812/

kai: quick result: forcing legacy rotary scale removed most of the rouge/perplexity gap (rougeL=0.40, ppx=19.8). looks like folded rotary path is applying headwise rescale differently after int4 kernels.

emma: great catch. next steps?

sanjeev: propose we: 1) add a unit test that checks per-head attention energy pre/post-quant on 2 representative prompts, 2) audit tokenmap remap pipeline for off-by-one in remap_v2.json, 3) add an A/B that pins rotary-scale=legacy for saffron until we pinpoint kernel mismatch.

caroline: +1. also flag for releases: add a note in onboarding checklist to run longctx regression test (>=4k) before rolling.

deploy-bot: note: canary rollout blocked if model variant has active regression alert.

emma: I'll open a small PR with the unit test and the pinned rotary flag. sanjeev can you attach the offending remap slice and the small repro prompt?

sanjeev: uploading the remap diff and a minimal repro here: 
```
Prompt: <SYSTEM> Summarize the following meeting notes: [~2500 tokens of meeting transcript...]
Observed: topic drifts to unrelated policy content after token 2100
Repro: runs on saffron-int4 with --tokenmap remap_v2.json and --rotary folded
```

kai: added local patch to quant kernels to normalize headwise scale after folding — preliminary looks good, but need CI run.

emma: awesome. thanks everyone. I'll track in the onboarding board under saffron-13b int4. tagging @caroline for release note. :white_check_mark:

caroline: ack.

sanjeev: final note — this feels like a combo bug: tokenmap remap + folded rotary headwise scaling + int4 kernel rounding. all three on the causal path. will prepare a short write-up after triage.

emma: please paste the short write-up in #eng-ml when ready. would like to avoid repeating for other models.

kai: cc @ml-ci-bot — can you schedule regression rerun across gemma/qwen/saffron after PR merges?

ml-ci-bot: scheduled: longctx-regression-suite for saffron, gemma-lite, qwen-7b queued (run_id=lr-173333).

sanjeev: thanks — closing the thread for now, will update with PR links. :slightly_smiling_face:
